search.query: | inputlookup ctf_registrations | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" status="registered" | where Team!="" | dedup Team | sort Team
| inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | dedup Number | sort Number

index=scoreboard ctf_id="$ctf_id$" user!=admin `validateevents` | dedup vcode | search Team="$team$" Number="$number$" | eventstats min(eval(if(BasePointsAwarded>0,_time,null))) as FC by Team Number | eventstats min(eval(if(AdditionalBonusAwarded>0,_time,null))) as FAB by Team Number | eval BP=if(_time=FC,BasePointsAwarded,0) | eval SB=if(_time=FC,SpeedBonusAwarded,0) | eval AB=if(_time=FAB,AdditionalBonusAwarded,0) | eval BP=coalesce(BP,0),SB=coalesce(SB,0),AB=coalesce(AB,0),Penalty=coalesce(Penalty,0) | eval Score=BP+SB+AB-Penalty | reverse | streamstats sum(Score) as CumulativeScore sum(BP) as CumulativeBasePoints sum(SB) as CumulativeSpeedBonus sum(AB) as CumulativeAdditionalBonus sum(Penalty) as CumulativePenalty by Team | table _time Number Result BasePointsAwarded SpeedBonusAwarded AdditionalBonusAwarded Penalty Team user Score CumulativeBasePoints CumulativeSpeedBonus CumulativeAdditionalBonus CumulativePenalty CumulativeScore
